CREATE TABLE production_tasks (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	package_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sample_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	round INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	latest_revision_id VARCHAR, 
	approved_revision_id VARCHAR, 
	annotator_id VARCHAR, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	display_rank INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, sample_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES production_projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(package_id) REFERENCES production_packages (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX production_task_next ON production_tasks (project_id, state, priority, id)
